description: Customs formalities in Ukraine (митне оформлення, розмитнення) for DHL and FedEx shipments. Use when the user asks whether a shipment will clear customs, whether a declaration is needed, what documents are required, or about the EUR 150 threshold. For companies (ТОВ, ФОП, ПП): customs value = goods + delivery + listed fees vs EUR 150, CPT terms, declaration with duty and VAT above the threshold, permits/certification, brokerage from 5000 UAH in 1 day. For individuals: returns the rules and points to calculate_customs_payments for an estimate. Ask who the recipient is first (company or individual). Never determines HS/УКТЗЕД codes — SEMERO's customs broker does.
